findings.affected_surface: public header commit.h — public inline compatibility wrappers removed
findings.old_behavior: struct commit_list *copy_commit_list(struct commit_list *l) — deprecated inline wrapper that delegated to commit_list_copy(l); struct commit_list *reverse_commit_list(struct commit_list *l) — deprecated inline wrapper that delegated to commit_list_reverse(l); void free_commit_list(struct commit_list *l) — deprecated inline wrapper that delegated to commit_list_free(l). The functions were declared static inline in public header commit.h with a deprecation notice stating removal after Git 2.53.
findings.new_behavior: The three deprecated inline wrapper functions are removed. Callers must use the long-form names commit_list_copy(), commit_list_reverse(), and commit_list_free() directly, which are still declared in commit.h at lines 199, 202, and 204 respectively.
findings.compatibility_reason: Any downstream code that includes commit.h and still calls the deprecated one-letter-form wrappers (copy_commit_list, reverse_commit_list, free_commit_list) will fail to compile after this change. The functions were explicitly deprecated with a planned removal timeline and were only provided as compatibility shims for in-flight upstream topics. Internal Git codebase has already been migrated in ancestor commit 7dd898a92 ('*: replace deprecated free_commit_list'), so only external consumers of Git's library headers are affected.
findings.why_not_internal_only: commit.h is a public header in Git's include path. The git package profile classifies '*.h' (excluding t/**) as public_library_headers — 'Headers used by Git builtins and external integrations'. External consumers of libgit.a or direct header inclusion may still reference these deprecated wrappers, and their removal constitutes a compile-time API breakage.
findings.uncertainty: Low. The functions were explicitly documented as deprecated and scheduled for removal. No remaining call sites exist in-tree (verified via git grep on base commit 7dd898a which migrated all internal usages). The only uncertainty is whether external consumers outside this repository still depend on them.
findings.recommended_review: Verify that no external Git plugin, git-submodule, or libgit consumer in the distribution depends on copy_commit_list, reverse_commit_list, or free_commit_list. The upstream Git tree has no remaining call sites.
findings.test_recommendation: Verify that the existing replacement names (commit_list_copy, commit_list_reverse, commit_list_free) are correctly declared and available at the same header location. Run a compile test to ensure no transitive header inclusion breaks.
